name: MIMIC-IV-Note: Deidentified Free-Text Clinical Notes
description: MIMIC-IV-Note is the official free-text clinical documentation module of the Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV (MIMIC-IV) database, published on PhysioNet by the MIT Laboratory for Computational Physiology. While structured EHR tables are distributed in the primary MIMIC-IV database, free-text clinical documents were separated into MIMIC-IV-Note to support specialized de-identification protocols. The database comprises 331,794 discharge summaries and 2,321,355 radiology reports across 145,915 unique patients admitted to Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center between 2008 and 2019. Discharge summaries provide comprehensive narratives of hospital courses, chief complaints, physical findings, and discharge medications, while radiology reports capture expert radiologist impressions across imaging examinations. Each note is linkable to MIMIC-IV structured tables via standard subject_id, hadm_id, and stay_id foreign keys, providing an unparalleled clinical NLP benchmark.
